leader.name: 梁文锋
leader.bio: 1985年生于广东湛江吴川，父母为小学教师。2002年以吴川一中高考状元考入浙江大学电子信息工程专业，2010年获硕士学位。2008年起探索机器学习量化交易，2015年创办幻方量化，2021年跻身千亿量化私募。2023年创立DeepSeek，专注AGI基础研究，风格极度低调，仅有两次“暗涌”专访。

leader.bioEn: Born in 1985 in Wuchuan, Zhanjiang, Guangdong, to primary-school teacher parents. Entered Zhejiang University in 2002 as the top gaokao scorer of Wuchuan No.1 Middle School, earning a master's in electronic information engineering in 2010. Began exploring ML-based quant trading in 2008, founded High-Flyer Quant in 2015, which became a 100-billion-yuan quant fund by 2021. Founded DeepSeek in 2023 to focus on AGI basic research. Famously low-profile, with only two Waves interviews on record.

strategy.summary: DeepSeek的战略近乎“反商业化的理想主义”：不做垂类应用、不投流买量，把全部资源押在基础模型与前沿创新上，期望其他公司在其模型之上构建toB、toC生态。梁文锋把护城河定义为“团队与组织文化”而非技术秘密，依靠幻方长期供血与提前储备的万张A100算力，在不融资、不上市的状态下完成从V2到R1的跃迁。2026年首次开放融资（估值3508亿元、定向邀请制、谢绝外资）标志其从“幻方的研究部门”走向独立平台，但“只负责基础模型”的定位与年轻化、无KPI的组织方式始终未变。

quotes.text: 我们目的地是 AGI，这意味着我们需要研究新的模型结构，在有限资源下，实现更强的模型能力。这是 scale up 到更大模型所需要做的基础研究之一。
quotes.textEn: Our destination is AGI, which means we must research new model structures to achieve stronger capabilities within limited resources. This is part of the basic research needed to scale up to larger models.

quotes.text: 我们的目标也很明确，就是不做垂类和应用，而是做研究，做探索。
quotes.textEn: Our goal is clear: no verticals, no applications — we do research and exploration.

quotes.text: 对顶级人才吸引最大的，肯定是去解决世界上最难的问题。其实，顶尖人才在中国是被低估的。
quotes.textEn: The greatest draw for top talent is solving the world's hardest problems. In fact, top talent in China is underrated.

strategy.summaryEn: DeepSeek's strategy borders on anti-commercial idealism: no vertical apps, no paid user acquisition — all resources go to foundation models and frontier innovation, expecting others to build the toB/toC ecosystem on top. Liang defines the moat as 'team and organizational culture' rather than technical secrets, and leapt from V2 to R1 without external funding or IPO, backed by High-Flyer's cash flow and a reserve of 10,000 A100 GPUs. Its first funding round in 2026 (¥350.8B valuation, invitation-only, no foreign capital) marks the shift from 'High-Flyer's research arm' to an independent platform — yet the 'foundation models only' positioning and the young, KPI-free organization remain unchanged.

agi.summary: 梁文锋对AGI的判断朴素而笃定：可能在2年、5年或10年内，“总之会在我们有生之年实现”。他押注三条路线——数学和代码、多模态、自然语言本身，其中数学和代码被视为AGI“封闭的、可验证的”天然试验场。更深一层，他猜想人类智能的本质可能就是语言，“你以为你在思考，其实可能是你在脑子里编织语言”，因此语言大模型上可能直接诞生类人智能。这套“语言即智能”的本体论解释了DeepSeek为何专注突破LLM。官方在V4发布时罕见坦率地自评仍落后GPT-5.4和Gemini-3.1-Pro约3至6个月。

quotes.text: （AGI）可能是 2 年、5 年或者 10 年，总之会在我们有生之年实现。至于路线图……我们确实押注了三个方向。一是数学和代码，二是多模态，三是自然语言本身。数学和代码是 AGI 天然的试验场，有点像围棋，是一个封闭的、可验证的系统。
quotes.textEn: (AGI) could take 2, 5 or 10 years — in any case, within our lifetime. As for the roadmap... we have indeed bet on three directions: math and code, multimodality, and natural language itself. Math and code are a natural proving ground for AGI — like Go, a closed, verifiable system.

quotes.text: 我们理解人类智能本质可能就是语言，人的思维可能就是一个语言的过程。你以为你在思考，其实可能是你在脑子里编织语言。这意味着，在语言大模型上可能诞生出类人的人工智能（AGI）。
quotes.textEn: We believe human intelligence may essentially be language; human thought may be a linguistic process. You think you are thinking, but you may be weaving language in your head. This means human-like AI (AGI) could emerge from large language models.

quotes.text: 感谢大家一直以来的信任。我们坚守长期主义，稳步朝着 AGI 这一终极目标不断迈进。
quotes.source: DeepSeek-V4 发布官方公告（framia转录）
quotes.textEn: Thank you for your continued trust. We remain committed to the long term, steadily advancing toward the ultimate goal of AGI.

agi.summaryEn: Liang's view of AGI is plain but firm: it may take 2, 5 or 10 years — 'in any case, within our lifetime.' He bets on three routes: math & code, multimodality, and natural language itself, with math & code as AGI's natural 'closed, verifiable' proving ground. Deeper still, he conjectures that human intelligence may essentially be language — 'you think you are thinking, but you may be weaving language in your head' — so human-like intelligence could emerge directly from LLMs. This 'language is intelligence' ontology explains DeepSeek's singular focus. In a rare candid moment, the official V4 announcement admitted still trailing GPT-5.4 and Gemini-3.1-Pro by roughly 3–6 months.

openSource.summary: DeepSeek是全球开源阵营的精神旗手。梁文锋认为“在颠覆性技术面前，闭源形成的护城河是短暂的”，OpenAI闭源也挡不住被赶超，所以把价值沉淀在团队而非权重上。他把开源定义为“文化行为而非商业行为”——“被follow是很有成就感的事”，并明确承诺“我们不会闭源”。行动上，从Coder到V4几乎全系以MIT协议开放，R1论文登上《Nature》封面；LMArena上V4-Pro是排名最高的MIT开源权重模型之一。网传“封闭技术是筑墙，开源才是建桥”并非其原话，未予收录。

quotes.text: 在颠覆性的技术面前，闭源形成的护城河是短暂的。即使 OpenAI 闭源，也无法阻止被别人赶超。所以我们把价值沉淀在团队上……形成可以创新的组织和文化，就是我们的护城河。
quotes.textEn: Against disruptive technology, a closed-source moat is short-lived. Even OpenAI's closure could not stop others from catching up. So we let value settle in the team... an organization and culture capable of innovation — that is our moat.

quotes.text: 开源，发论文，其实并没有失去什么。对于技术人员来说，被 follow 是很有成就感的事。其实，开源更像一个文化行为，而非商业行为。给予其实是一种额外的荣誉。
quotes.textEn: Open-sourcing and publishing papers don't really cost us anything. For technologists, being followed is deeply rewarding. Open source is more a cultural act than a commercial one — giving is an extra honor.

quotes.text: 我们不会闭源。我们认为先有一个强大的技术生态更重要。
quotes.textEn: We will not go closed-source. We believe a strong technology ecosystem comes first.

quotes.text: 无论 API，还是 AI，都应该是普惠的、人人可以用得起的东西。
quotes.textEn: Whether APIs or AI, both should be inclusive — affordable for everyone.

openSource.summaryEn: DeepSeek is the spiritual flag-bearer of the global open-source camp. Liang argues that 'against disruptive technology, a closed-source moat is short-lived' — even OpenAI's closure couldn't prevent being overtaken — so value should settle in the team, not the weights. He calls open source 'a cultural act, not a commercial one' ('being followed is deeply rewarding') and has promised plainly: 'we will not go closed-source.' From Coder to V4, nearly everything ships under MIT; the R1 paper made the cover of Nature. The viral line 'closed tech builds walls, open source builds bridges' is misattributed and excluded.

leader.bioEn: Zhang Peng, formerly an associate researcher at Tsinghua's KEG lab, has been CEO since Zhipu's founding in 2019 and is the chief architect of its MaaS (Model-as-a-Service) commercialization, leading the company from a Tsinghua lab to the 'world's first foundation-model stock.' Chief scientist Tang Jie, a Tsinghua chair professor and creator of the GLM architecture, shares leadership of research and operations with Zhang.

strategy.summary: 智谱的战略是“学院派的务实主义”：从第一天就拒绝“做中国的ChatGPT”，认定预训练模型不是AGI的终极方案，走通用基座+MaaS的中间路线——不做行业模型，而是把模型做成像水电燃气一样的基础设施，以To B养活长期研究。这套“左手开源赚生态、右手闭源赚利润”的双轨使其成为国内商业化最完整的大模型公司：2026年3月开放平台API年化收入达17亿元，一年提升60倍。张鹏称“不管融多少、挣多少钱，都是通向AGI这条路上的盘缠”，道出其对资本的工具化态度。

quotes.text: 我们的认知可以概括为：不把目标定为‘做中国的ChatGPT’。从成立起我们就认为预训练模型是一项革命性的技术，但它有自己的问题，不能包治百病，可能也不是AGI的终极方案。
quotes.textEn: Our understanding can be summarized as: don't set the goal of 'building China's ChatGPT.' From day one we believed pre-trained models are revolutionary, but they have their own problems — they can't cure everything, and may not be the ultimate answer to AGI.

quotes.text: 行业模型本质上是用大模型的壳，重复造了一遍传统算法的轮子。我们认为只有一定规模的（通用）大模型，才能实现类人的认知能力涌现。
quotes.textEn: Industry models essentially put an LLM shell on reinvented traditional algorithms. We believe only general models of sufficient scale can produce human-like cognitive emergence.

quotes.text: 我们提出 MaaS，Model as a Service，把模型本身变成一种服务，让大家能理解、使用，嵌入到产品、系统、生活中……大模型未来有个确定性方向是越来越向基础设施演进，像水电燃气。
quotes.textEn: We proposed MaaS — Model as a Service — making the model itself a service that everyone can understand, use, and embed into products, systems and daily life... A certainty is that LLMs will evolve toward infrastructure, like water, electricity and gas.

strategy.summaryEn: Zhipu's strategy is pragmatic academicism: from day one it refused to 'build China's ChatGPT', judging pre-trained models not to be the ultimate AGI answer, and took a middle route of general foundation models + MaaS — no industry-specific models, instead making models infrastructure 'like water, electricity and gas', with To B revenue funding long-term research. This dual track of 'open source for ecosystem, closed source for profit' made it China's most commercially complete model company: annualized open-platform API revenue reached ¥1.7B in March 2026, up 60x in a year. 'However much we raise or earn, it is all traveling money on the road to AGI,' Zhang says — capital as a tool, nothing more.

agi.summary: 智谱对AGI的态度是“理想主义的自我纠偏”。唐杰在上市当日内部信中坦承，公司追逐AGI的路上“有迷失的时候，会被眼前的短期收益、短期热闹所迷惑”，宣布全面回归基础模型研究；他把AGI定义为“平权的技术变革”——要公开透明、让所有人用得上并获益。同时他对中美差距保持罕见的清醒：榜单追平不等于差距缩小，美国实验室“仍握有大量未公开的闭源技术和更大规模的算力集群”。面对马斯克“中国2027年才能匹敌Anthropic”的判断，唐杰只回了五个字：“不需要那么久。”

quotes.text: 可能原因是我们自己在追逐 AGI 的路上有迷失的时候，会被眼前的短期收益、短期热闹所迷惑。AGI 是个技术变革，技术是平权的，是公开透明的，是要让所有人都能用得上并从中获益。
quotes.source: 唐杰上市当日内部信（晚点/新浪财经）
quotes.textEn: Perhaps it's because we sometimes lost our way chasing AGI, distracted by short-term gains and short-term excitement. AGI is a technological change — technology is egalitarian, open and transparent, and should be usable and beneficial to everyone.

quotes.text: 这是一个无与伦比的开心时刻，这种开心不是一时的多巴胺，而是探索 AGI 之路上积累起来的内啡肽，让我们更加专注，脚踏实地，持续前行！
quotes.source: 唐杰上市当日内部信（晚点/新浪财经）
quotes.textEn: This is an incomparably happy moment — not a flash of dopamine, but endorphins accumulated on the road of exploring AGI, keeping us focused, grounded and moving forward!

quotes.text: 我们希望拥有解决多场景、多任务甚至跨模态的技术，不会把模型局限在具体任务、场景甚至垂直行业里……最终我们还是得推动 AGI，不能停留在一个阶段性目标上。
quotes.textEn: We want technology that handles multi-scenario, multi-task and even cross-modal problems; we won't confine models to specific tasks, scenarios or verticals... In the end we must keep pushing AGI; we can't stop at an interim goal.

agi.summaryEn: Zhipu's stance on AGI is idealism with self-correction. In his IPO-day internal letter, Tang Jie admitted the company had at times been 'distracted by short-term gains and short-term excitement' on the road to AGI, and announced a full return to foundation-model research. He defines AGI as 'an egalitarian technological change' — open, transparent, usable and beneficial to all. He stays unusually sober about the China–US gap: tying the leaderboards does not mean the gap has closed, as US labs 'still hold substantial undisclosed closed technology and larger compute clusters.' Asked about Musk's claim that China could only match Anthropic by 2027, Tang replied in five words: 'It won't take that long.'

openSource.summary: 智谱是国内开源历史最久的大模型公司：从2021年GLM-10B、2022年千亿级GLM-130B，到ChatGLM-6B全球下载超千万，再到GLM-4.5至5.2全线MIT开源，每代旗舰都配开源版。张鹏的“生物圈论”是其开源哲学的核心：闭源是商业路径，开源是为了丰富生态、促进创新，“就像生物圈一样，必须保持一定的多样性”。这套理念换来实质回报：GLM-5.2以51分登顶Artificial Analysis开源智能指数，富瑞研报称其位列全球第三，是中国模型首次进入前三。

quotes.text: 我们一直认为开源和闭源它们本质的目标和意义是不一样的。闭源更多是从商业化的角度来考虑……而在大模型开源这件事情上，它的目的主要是为了丰富生态，促进技术的创新。任何一项技术如果单纯走向一个封闭而且垄断的发展路径，要么就是活力不够，要么就是会变成一个对整个生态不太友好的状态。就像生物圈一样，必须要保持一定的多样性。
quotes.source: 张鹏 爱范儿专访/科学网
quotes.textEn: We've always believed open source and closed source have fundamentally different goals. Closed source is mostly about commercialization... while open-sourcing foundation models aims to enrich the ecosystem and drive innovation. Any technology that follows a purely closed and monopolistic path will either lose vitality or...

quotes.text: 开源和闭源不是对立的。开源的最终目标是鼓励开发者深入参与到技术核心发展，以保持持续创新。
quotes.textEn: Open source and closed source are not opposites. The ultimate goal of open source is to engage developers deeply in the core of the technology, sustaining innovation.

openSource.summaryEn: Zhipu has China's longest open-source track record: GLM-10B in 2021, the 100B-scale GLM-130B in 2022, ChatGLM-6B with 10M+ global downloads, and the full GLM-4.5→5.2 line under MIT — every flagship ships with an open release. Zhang's 'biosphere theory' is the core of his open-source philosophy: closed source is a business path, while open source enriches the ecosystem and drives innovation — 'like a biosphere, diversity must be preserved.' The payoff is real: GLM-5.2 topped Artificial Analysis' open-source intelligence index at 51 points, and Jefferies ranked it third globally — a first for a Chinese model.

leader.bio: 1989年生，河南县城出身，清华大学博士（国内第一批深度学习方向博士生），2014年在百度实习做语音识别时亲历Scaling Law早期发现，曾任商汤科技副总裁、商汤研究院副院长。2021年12月创立MiniMax，以低调著称，2025年12月与罗永浩四小时对谈后“出圈”。2026年7月宣布实现AGI前不再领取薪酬。

leader.bioEn: Born in 1989 in a county town in Henan, Yan Junjie earned a PhD at Tsinghua among China's first deep-learning doctoral cohort, witnessed early Scaling Law discoveries during a 2014 Baidu speech-recognition internship, and later served as VP of SenseTime and deputy head of SenseTime Research. He founded MiniMax in December 2021. Long low-profile, he broke out after a four-hour conversation with Luo Yonghao in December 2025. In July 2026 he pledged to take no salary until AGI is achieved.

strategy.summary: MiniMax的战略是“全模态的第一性原理”：闫俊杰认定真正的AGI一定是多模态输入、多模态输出，若不同步推进，未来的技术债会成为致命伤——因此创业第一天就文本、语音、视频、音乐四线并行。在产品侧，他坚持“模型即产品”，拒绝用移动互联网推荐系统的方法论做AI产品，并把重心放在付费意愿更强的海外C端市场（Talkie、海螺AI），使公司超七成收入来自C端、海外收入占比约73%。面对与美国同行百倍的估值与资金差距，他的答案是“用1/50的筹码通往AGI”——靠技术进化速度而非资源堆叠取胜。

quotes.text: 他们一开始就想得很清楚，真正的 AGI 一定是多模态的输入、多模态的输出。AGI 的本质是多模态融合，如果现在不同步推进，等到需要融合时技术债会成为致命伤。
quotes.source: 爱范儿·罗永浩四小时对谈文字版
quotes.textEn: They saw it clearly from the start: true AGI must be multimodal in input and output. The essence of AGI is multimodal fusion — if you don't advance all modalities in parallel, the technical debt becomes fatal when fusion is needed.

quotes.text: 美国最好的公司的估值是中国创业公司的 100 倍，收入基本上也是 100 倍，但技术可能就领先 5%，花的钱大概是 50 到 100 倍之间。
quotes.source: 爱范儿·罗永浩四小时对谈文字版
quotes.textEn: The best US companies are valued at 100x Chinese startups, with roughly 100x the revenue — yet their technology leads by maybe 5%, on 50 to 100 times the spending.

quotes.text: 千万不要用上一代移动互联网产品方法论来思考新产品。中国大部分公司，不管创业公司还是大厂，都还在用做推荐系统的方法来做大模型产品。
quotes.textEn: Never think about new products with last-generation mobile-internet methodology. Most Chinese companies, startups and big tech alike, are still building LLM products the way they built recommendation systems.

strategy.summaryEn: MiniMax's strategy is full-modality first-principles thinking: Yan is convinced true AGI must be multimodal in and multimodal out, and that deferring any modality creates fatal technical debt — so text, voice, video and music ran in parallel from day one. On products, he insists 'the model is the product', refuses to apply mobile-internet recommendation-system methodology to AI, and focuses on overseas consumer markets with stronger willingness to pay (Talkie, Hailuo AI): over 70% of revenue comes from consumer products and about 73% from overseas. Facing US rivals valued at 100x with 100x the funding, his answer is 'reaching AGI with 1/50 of the chips' — winning on the speed of technical evolution, not resource stacking.

agi.summary: 闫俊杰的AGI观带有强烈的“普惠”底色：AGI一定会实现，而且一定是服务大众的事——它应该属于所有AI公司和用户，而非某一家公司。他断言AI不会被单一公司垄断：对齐目标反映不同价值观、单一模型优势在多Agent系统中会变弱、开源模型影响力越来越大。他把创业初心归结为“一定要做天花板最高的事情”，并区分“信仰”与“信念”——信念是想清楚怎么做并坚持走下去。2026年7月完成160亿港元融资时，他宣布实现AGI前不再领取薪酬，并捐出个人持股4%激励团队。

quotes.text: AGI 一定会实现，并且一定是服务大众的一件事。AI 的模型或者 AGI，它应该属于所有 AI 公司和它的用户，而不是只属于单独一家公司，我们也愿意长期为这个目标而奋斗。
quotes.source: WAIC 2025 主论坛演讲《每个人的 AI》（新浪科技）
quotes.textEn: AGI will surely arrive, and it must be something that serves the public. AI models — AGI — should belong to all AI companies and their users, not to any single company. We are willing to strive for that goal for the long term.

quotes.text: 信仰，有点像描述一个很远的未来；信念是，自己想怎么做，并能坚持做下去。一年前最喜欢说信仰的那些人，信仰都兑现了吗？
quotes.textEn: Faith is like describing a distant future; conviction is knowing how you want to do it and persisting. Those who loved talking about faith a year ago — has their faith been redeemed?

quotes.text: 再往后三年看，即使不是我们，也会有中国其他的人能够做到这件事（全球技术引领）。
quotes.source: 爱范儿·罗永浩四小时对谈文字版
quotes.textEn: Looking three years ahead, even if it's not us, someone else in China will achieve global technical leadership.

agi.summaryEn: Yan's AGI outlook has a strong 'for everyone' streak: AGI will surely arrive, and it must serve the public — it should belong to all AI companies and their users, not to any single company. He asserts AI won't be monopolized by one player: alignment targets reflect different values, a single model's edge weakens in multi-agent systems, and open-source influence keeps growing. He frames the founding mission as 'always attempting the highest ceiling', and distinguishes 'faith' from 'conviction' — conviction is knowing how and persisting. After closing a HK$16B round in July 2026, he pledged no salary until AGI and donated 4% of his personal shares to incentivize the team.

openSource.summary: MiniMax是“迟到的开源皈依者”。闫俊杰公开反思：“如果重新选，第一天就应该开源，因为开源能加速技术进化”——真正有价值的不是当前做得怎么样，而是技术进化速度。行动上，公司自2025年1月开源MiniMax-01起加速转向：M1“开源周”五连发、M2.7与M3相继开放权重，官方称开源意在“激发长上下文与Agent研究”。不过M2.7采用“修改版MIT+商用需书面授权”，属开放权重而非OSI意义的开源，开放程度仍略逊于DeepSeek与智谱的全MIT路线。

quotes.text: 如果重新选，第一天就应该开源。因为开源能加速技术进化。真正有价值的事，不是当前做得怎么样，而是技术进化速度。而开源会加速技术进化，做得好的地方有鼓励，不好的地方会有很多批评，外面的人也会有贡献，这是我们开源的最大驱动力。
quotes.textEn: If I could choose again, I would open-source from day one, because open source accelerates technical evolution. What truly matters is not how good you are now, but the speed of evolution. Open source accelerates it: good work gets encouragement, bad work gets criticized, outsiders contribute — that is our biggest driver for open-sourcing.

quotes.text: 过去一年开源模型如雨后春笋般涌现……当前最好的模型依旧是闭源模型，但好的开源模型越来越多，也在不断逼近最好的闭源模型。
quotes.textEn: In the past year open-source models have sprung up like mushrooms... The best models today are still closed, but good open models are multiplying and closing in on the best closed ones.

openSource.summaryEn: MiniMax is a late convert to open source. Yan publicly reflected: 'If I could choose again, I would open-source from day one, because open source accelerates technical evolution' — what matters is not how good you are now, but the speed of evolution. In action, the company pivoted fast after open-sourcing MiniMax-01 in January 2025: the M1 'open-source week' with five releases, then M2.7 and M3 weights, officially to 'stimulate long-context and agent research.' Note, however, that M2.7 uses a 'modified MIT with written commercial authorization' — open weights rather than OSI-defined open source, a notch below DeepSeek's and Zhipu's full-MIT route.

leader.bioEn: One of Alibaba's '18 Arhats' founding members and a first-generation programmer; formerly CTO of Taobao and chairman of Alibaba Health. Became Alibaba Group CEO in September 2023, issuing the 'user first, AI-driven' strategy in an all-hands letter on his third day. At Apsara Conference 2025 he delivered the keynote 'The Road to Superintelligence', laying out a three-stage path from AGI to ASI and a ¥380B AI-infrastructure investment.

strategy.summary: 阿里的AI战略是“全栈豪赌”：吴泳铭将大模型定义为“下一代操作系统”、超级AI云是“下一代的计算机”、Token是“未来的电”，据此宣布三年3800亿元AI基建投入。Qwen刻意走“AI时代的Android”路线——以开源模型矩阵渗透全球开发者（下载量超10亿、衍生模型超20万），同时保留Qwen-Max闭源旗舰；2025年11月推出集团战略级“千问App”，7天下载破千万，打通淘宝、支付宝、高德生态。周靖人则点出本质：“模型之间的竞争是系统的竞争，云的竞争也是模型的竞争”，全栈自研是阿里最大的牌。

quotes.text: 大模型是下一代的操作系统。超级AI云是下一代的计算机。Token就是未来的电。
quotes.source: 2025云栖大会主旨演讲《超级人工智能之路》
quotes.textEn: Foundation models are the next-generation operating system. Super AI cloud is the next-generation computer. Tokens are the electricity of the future.

quotes.text: 我们看到整个行业，各家模型的能力提升速度没有任何减缓，全球在这方面的投资也在加速，AI大模型的上限还没有看到。今天模型之间的竞争，其实也是系统的竞争；今天云的竞争，也是模型的竞争。
quotes.source: 周靖人 云栖大会媒体采访（北京商报）
quotes.textEn: Across the industry, model capabilities are not slowing at all, and global investment is accelerating — the ceiling of LLMs is not in sight. Competition between models today is also competition between systems; competition between clouds is competition between models.

quotes.text: 关于AI的未来，我们不知道的比知道的多，难以想象的比可以预测的多。计算的范式正在发生根本性变化，AI驱动的云计算体系正在超越传统计算体系，成为数字世界的基石，最终将会接管所有计算资源。
quotes.source: 吴泳铭 世界互联网大会乌镇峰会演讲（C114引述）
quotes.textEn: About AI's future, what we don't know exceeds what we know; the unimaginable exceeds the predictable. The computing paradigm is changing fundamentally — AI-driven cloud computing is surpassing traditional computing to become the bedrock of the digital world, and will eventually take over all computing resources.

strategy.summaryEn: Alibaba's AI strategy is a full-stack bet: Wu Yongming defines foundation models as 'the next-generation operating system', super AI cloud as 'the next-generation computer', and tokens as 'the electricity of the future' — backed by a ¥380B three-year infrastructure plan. Qwen deliberately plays 'the Android of the AI era': an open-model matrix penetrating global developers (1B+ downloads, 200K+ derivative models) alongside the closed Qwen-Max flagship; in November 2025 the group-level Qwen App launched, passing 10M downloads in seven days and wiring into Taobao, Alipay and Amap. Zhou Jingren names the essence: 'competition between models is competition between systems; competition between clouds is also competition between models' — full-stack self-research is Alibaba's trump card.

agi.summary: 吴泳铭在2025云栖大会上提出了大厂中最激进的AGI叙事：“AGI并非AI发展的终点，而是全新的起点”，AI将迈向能自我迭代进化的超级人工智能（ASI），并给出“智能涌现→自主行动→自我迭代”的三阶段路线。这一“ASI终局论”为阿里的全栈投入提供了合法性——如果智能的上限远超人类，那么算力、云、模型、应用的全链条布局就不是过度投资而是必要卡位。与创业公司谈AGI理想不同，阿里的AGI话语始终与商业基础设施绑定：Token是电、云是计算机、模型是操作系统，AGI叙事本身就是其商业叙事的延伸。

quotes.text: AGI并非AI发展的终点，而是全新的起点。AI不会止步于AGI，它将迈向超越人类智能、能够自我迭代进化的超级人工智能（ASI）。
quotes.textEn: AGI is not the endpoint of AI development, but a brand-new starting point. AI will not stop at AGI — it will move toward superintelligence (ASI) that surpasses human intelligence and can iterate and evolve on its own.

quotes.text: 我们一直在跟全球这个领域的领先者来你追我赶。阿里云是全球少数几家在大模型和云计算方面都能够做到全栈自研，能够做到联合创新的云计算公司。
quotes.source: 周靖人 云栖大会媒体采访（北京商报）
quotes.textEn: We have been neck and neck with global leaders in this field. Alibaba Cloud is one of the few cloud companies worldwide capable of full-stack self-research and joint innovation across both foundation models and cloud computing.

agi.summaryEn: At Apsara 2025 Wu laid out the most aggressive AGI narrative among big tech: 'AGI is not the endpoint of AI, but a brand-new starting point' — AI will move toward self-improving artificial superintelligence (ASI), along a three-stage route of 'intelligence emergence → autonomous action → self-iteration.' This 'ASI endgame' legitimizes Alibaba's full-stack spending: if the ceiling of intelligence far exceeds humans, then compute, cloud, models and applications are necessary positioning, not over-investment. Unlike startup idealism, Alibaba's AGI discourse is always bound to commercial infrastructure: tokens are electricity, cloud is the computer, models are the OS — the AGI narrative is an extension of its business narrative.

openSource.summary: 阿里是中国大厂中最坚定的开源派。吴泳铭将其上升为“战略选择”：“在LLM时代，开源模型创造的价值和能渗透的场景，会远远大于闭源模型”，目标是打造“AI时代的Android”。周靖人更直白：“现在已是2024年，如果还有人对开源的价值有疑惑，可能真不是活在我们这个时代”，并强调“要做开源最强的模型”。结果是Qwen建成“全球第一开源模型矩阵”（开源300余款、全模态全尺寸），2025年10月下载量超越Llama。但阿里并非纯开源信徒——闭源旗舰始终存在，开源本质是云计算的获客与生态入口。

quotes.text: 我们做了一个战略选择：通义千问选择开放路线，打造AI时代的Android。我们认为在LLM时代，开源模型创造的价值和能渗透的场景，会远远大于闭源模型，我们坚定选择开源，就是为了全力支持开发者生态，与全球所有开发者一起探索AI应用的无限可能。
quotes.textEn: We made a strategic choice: Tongyi Qianwen takes the open route, building the Android of the AI era. In the LLM era, open models will create far more value and penetrate far more scenarios than closed ones. We firmly choose open source to fully support the developer ecosystem and explore the infinite possibilities of AI applications with developers worldwide.

quotes.text: 现在已是2024年，如果还有人对开源的价值有疑惑的话，可能真不是活在我们这个时代。阿里云不是说简简单单的开源，而是要做开源最强的模型。开源代表了阿里的一种胸怀……把最先进的技术跟产业应用有机融合在一起，让更多的人给到反馈。
quotes.source: 周靖人 通义千问2.5发布沟通会（搜狐科技）
quotes.textEn: It is 2024 — if anyone still doubts the value of open source, they may truly not be living in our era. Alibaba Cloud is not about casual open-sourcing; we aim to build the strongest open-source models. Open source represents Alibaba's breadth of mind... organically fusing the most advanced technology with industrial application, and letting more people give feedback.

openSource.summaryEn: Alibaba is the staunchest open-source advocate among Chinese big tech. Wu elevated it to a 'strategic choice': 'In the LLM era, the value open models create and the scenarios they penetrate will far exceed closed models' — the goal being 'the Android of the AI era.' Zhou Jingren is blunter: 'It is 2024; if anyone still doubts the value of open source, they may not be living in our era', vowing to build 'the strongest open-source models.' The result: Qwen built the 'world's No.1 open-model matrix' (300+ releases, all modalities and sizes), overtaking Llama in downloads in October 2025. Yet Alibaba is no open-source purist — the closed flagship remains; open source is ultimately customer acquisition and an ecosystem funnel for the cloud.

Graduated first in his year at Tsinghua CS (admitted as the province's science-track top scorer), PhD at Carnegie Mellon, first author of Transformer-XL and XLNet, and one of the most-cited researchers in Chinese AI. Founded Moonshot AI in April 2023 — named after a Pink Floyd album. Once the drummer of a Tsinghua rock band, he describes his AGI route as 'climbing an infinite mountain.'

strategy.summary: 月之暗面的战略是“断臂后的all in”：Kimi k1.5与DeepSeek-R1同日发布、流量被碾压后，公司停止年耗超7亿元的投流买量、砍掉泛娱乐产品线，从“C端超级应用”转向“开源SOTA基座+Agent”，2025年“只做了一件事：All in模型能力和Agent”。杨植麟主张Token效率×长上下文×Agent集群三维共振，底层创新连续发布。路线在2026年兑现：K2.5发布20天收入超2025全年，K3以2.8万亿参数冲上AA全球第3，他也成为唯一受邀在英伟达GTC演讲的中国独立大模型创始人。

quotes.text: 做模型的过程本质上是在创造一种世界观，即你觉得什么样的东西是好的。希望在接下来的十年、二十年的时间，继续把K4、K5到K100做得更好。
quotes.source: AGI-Next前沿峰会演讲（东方财富/每经）
quotes.textEn: Building a model is essentially creating a worldview — deciding what you think is good. I hope that over the next ten or twenty years we keep making K4, K5, all the way to K100, better and better.

quotes.text: 2025年可以说只做了一件事，All in模型能力和Agent。相比于二级市场，我们判断还可以从一级市场募集更大量资金，所以我们短期不着急上市。
quotes.source: 杨植麟内部信（钛媒体转述）
quotes.textEn: In 2025 we did only one thing: all in on model capability and agents. Compared with the secondary market, we believe we can raise even more from the primary market, so we are in no hurry to go public.

quotes.text: 有时每天起床都感觉公司要挂了。真正决定胜负的，是你如何组织构建模型的人。
quotes.source: 钛媒体影像采访（新浪财经转述）
quotes.textEn: Some days I wake up feeling the company is about to die. What truly decides the outcome is how you organize the people who build the model.

strategy.summaryEn: Moonshot's strategy is an all-in after cutting off an arm: after Kimi k1.5 launched the same day as DeepSeek-R1 and was crushed in traffic, the company stopped its ¥700M-a-year paid user acquisition, axed its entertainment product lines, and pivoted from 'consumer super app' to 'open-source SOTA foundation + agents' — in 2025 it 'did only one thing: all in on model capability and agents.' Yang champions a triad of token efficiency × long context × agent swarms, with continuous底层 innovation. The route paid off in 2026: K2.5 earned more in 20 days than all of 2025, K3 hit global #3 on Artificial Analysis with 2.8T parameters, and Yang became the only independent Chinese model founder invited to speak at NVIDIA GTC.

agi.summary: 杨植麟把AGI研发比作攀登“无限的山”：没有终极顶点，核心理念是“问题不可避免，但问题可以解决”。这种无限博弈的心态塑造了其独特的工程师气质——K2登顶开源榜后面对祝贺，他只回应“得搞下一个大模型了”；同时又坦言“有时每天起床都感觉公司要挂了”，危机感与长期主义并存。他认为做模型的本质是在创造一种世界观，胜负手不在算力规模而在“如何组织构建模型的人”。在2026年AGI-Next峰会上，他把目标拉长到“K4、K5到K100”，用十年二十年的尺度理解这场竞赛，是中国创始人中最具研究本能的一位。

quotes.text: 真正决定胜负的，是你如何组织构建模型的人。
quotes.source: 钛媒体影像采访（新浪财经转述）
quotes.textEn: What truly decides the outcome is how you organize the people who build the model.

quotes.text: 问题不可避免，但问题可以解决。
quotes.source: 新京报《未来领跑者》/《中国AI 50人》专访（“攀登无限的山”核心理念）
quotes.textEn: Problems are inevitable, but problems can be solved.

quotes.text: 得搞下一个大模型了。
quotes.source: 《中国AI 50人》专访（K2登顶开源榜后对祝贺的回应，雪球转载）
quotes.textEn: Time to build the next big model.

agi.summaryEn: Yang likens AGI research to climbing an 'infinite mountain': no final summit; the creed is 'problems are inevitable, but problems can be solved.' This infinite-game mindset shapes his engineer's temperament — after K2 topped the open-source charts, his only response to congratulations was 'time to build the next big model'; yet he also confesses that 'some days I wake up feeling the company is about to die.' He believes building models is essentially creating a worldview, and the deciding factor is not compute scale but 'how you organize the people who build the model.' At AGI-Next 2026 he stretched the horizon to 'K4, K5, all the way to K100' — thinking in decades, the most research-instinctive founder among his Chinese peers.

openSource.summary: 月之暗面是“被DeepSeek逼进开源阵营”的典型：2025年7月开源万亿参数的Kimi K2（MIT协议），被《自然》称为“又一个DeepSeek时刻”，此后K2 Thinking、K2.5、K2.6、K3连续开源，彻底完成从闭源到开源的转身。杨植麟将开源视为对生态的贡献，并在GTC 2026承诺把MuonClip、Kimi Linear、Attention Residuals等创新持续贡献给社区。开源带来实打实的回报：K3发布48小时即挤爆服务器。

quotes.text: Kimi K2的发布不仅是技术突破，更是对开源AI生态的重要贡献。通过开源这一万亿参数级的模型，公司希望能够推动整个AI行业的发展。
quotes.source: K2发布表态（深圳新闻网等）
quotes.textEn: The release of Kimi K2 is not only a technical breakthrough but an important contribution to the open-source AI ecosystem. By open-sourcing a trillion-parameter model, the company hopes to advance the entire AI industry.

quotes.text: Kimi将继续坚持开源路径，将 MuonClip、Kimi Linear 和 Attention Residuals 等底层创新贡献给开源社区。
quotes.textEn: Kimi will stay on the open-source path, contributing底层 innovations such as MuonClip, Kimi Linear and Attention Residuals to the open-source community.

openSource.summaryEn: Moonshot is the classic case of being pushed into the open-source camp by DeepSeek: in July 2025 it open-sourced the trillion-parameter Kimi K2 under MIT, which Nature called 'another DeepSeek moment'; K2 Thinking, K2.5, K2.6 and K3 followed, completing a full turn from closed to open. Yang frames open source as a contribution to the ecosystem, promising at GTC 2026 to keep contributing MuonClip, Kimi Linear and Attention Residuals to the community. The returns are tangible: K3 overwhelmed its servers within 48 hours of release.

leader.bioEn: A Nankai University CS graduate, Zhang Yiming's college roommate and ByteDance co-founder; formerly head of technology, head of Lark and efficiency engineering, and head of HR, becoming ByteDance CEO in November 2021. In 2026 he campaigned intensively for AI: setting the tone of 'climbing to the summit' at the January all-hands, and giving his first public AI-strategy talk at the Volcano Engine FORCE conference in June, listing frontier model capability as the top priority.

strategy.summary: 字节的AI战略是“高峰论”：梁汝波判断AI至少是PC+互联网级别的产业高峰，但高峰机会的窗口越来越短，因此持续收缩业务宽度、聚焦AI、在AI里再聚焦模型能力。其独特打法是“用流量养模型、用模型促流量”的双轮——C端豆包月活3.45亿做中国最大AI应用，B端火山引擎MaaS以49.5%份额居国内第一，日均Token调用量超180万亿。他同时保持罕见的坦率：承认基础模型“和全球最头部的同行比还有差距”，并强调攀登AI高峰“绝不是某一家公司可以独自完成的”。2026年算力预算超2000亿元是All in的注脚。

quotes.text: AI时代存在很多重要的机会，我们要追求其中最重要的，去攀登最高的高峰。后面的高峰比前面高，AI至少是PC+互联网这个级别的高峰。高峰机会的持续时间越来越短……攀高峰的时间窗口在变短。
quotes.source: 字节跳动2026年首次全员会（新京报/澎湃）
quotes.textEn: The AI era holds many important opportunities; we must pursue the most important ones and climb the highest summit. Later summits are higher than earlier ones — AI is at least a PC-plus-internet-scale summit. The window for summit opportunities keeps shrinking... the time window for climbing is getting shorter.

quotes.text: 字节跳动的基础模型综合实力处于中国第一梯队，图像和视频生成模型综合能力处于国际第一梯队；豆包的用户规模和增长都比较快，产品体验也有提升，但和全球最头部的同行比还有差距。
quotes.source: 字节跳动2026年首次全员会
quotes.textEn: ByteDance's foundation models are in China's first tier in overall capability, and our image and video generation models are in the international first tier. Doubao's user scale and growth are strong and the product experience keeps improving — but compared with the very top global peers, there is still a gap.

quotes.text: 过去几年，我们一直在收缩业务宽度，把精力聚焦到AI，在AI领域聚焦到提升模型能力。火山MaaS业务正在变成字节的基础业务，我们的投入将长期且坚定。攀登高峰，绝不是某一家公司可以独自完成的。
quotes.source: 火山引擎FORCE大会视频演讲（科创板日报）
quotes.textEn: Over the past few years we have been narrowing our business scope, focusing our energy on AI, and within AI on improving model capability. The Volcano MaaS business is becoming a foundational business of ByteDance; our investment will be long-term and firm. Climbing the summit can never be accomplished by any single company alone.

strategy.summaryEn: ByteDance's AI strategy is the 'summit theory': Liang judges AI to be at least a PC-plus-internet-scale industrial summit, but with ever-shorter windows — so the company keeps narrowing business scope, focusing on AI, and within AI focusing on model capability. Its signature flywheel is 'traffic feeds the model, the model feeds traffic': Doubao as China's largest AI app (345M MAU) on the consumer side, and Volcano Engine MaaS with 49.5% domestic share and 180T+ daily tokens on the enterprise side. He stays unusually candid: admitting the foundation model 'still trails the very top global peers', and stressing that climbing the AI summit 'can never be accomplished by any single company alone.' A 2026 compute budget exceeding ¥200B footnotes the all-in.

agi.summary: 字节很少直接谈“AGI”，而是以“探索智能上限”作为组织级目标：2025年2月前Google DeepMind副总裁吴永辉加入任Seed基础研究负责人，AI Lab并入Seed，并取消AGI研究团队的季度/半年考核，给长期研究松绑。梁汝波把AGI话语转译为工程目标——“模型能力要做到行业前列”“推动模型追求智能上限”；同时把AI定位为与PC、Web、Mobile同级的产业高峰，暗含对通用智能量级机会的认可。哈萨比斯公开称“字节是中国最强的AI公司”，侧面印证其实力已进入全球第一梯队的讨论范围。

quotes.text: 短期内高峰就是做好豆包/Dola助手应用……重中之重，是AI模型能力要做到行业前列。同时做好To C助手和To B MaaS，模型能力才能更全面，才能推动模型追求智能上限。
quotes.source: 字节跳动2026年首次全员会
quotes.textEn: In the near term, the summit is doing the Doubao/Dola assistant apps well... The top priority is for AI model capability to reach the industry's front rank. Doing both the consumer assistant and enterprise MaaS well makes model capability more complete, pushing models toward the upper limits of intelligence.

quotes.text: AI的发展仍处于早期阶段。越是这个时候，我们越要回到基本面：追求长期价值，追求真实场景，追求对客户真正有用的结果。
quotes.source: 火山引擎FORCE大会视频演讲（科创板日报）
quotes.textEn: The development of AI is still in an early stage. The more so, the more we must return to fundamentals: pursuing long-term value, real scenarios, and results that are genuinely useful to customers.

agi.summaryEn: ByteDance rarely says 'AGI', preferring the organizational goal of 'exploring the upper limits of intelligence': in February 2025 former Google DeepMind VP Wu Yonghui joined as head of Seed basic research, the AI Lab was folded into Seed, and quarterly/semi-annual reviews for AGI research teams were abolished to unshackle long-term research. Liang translates AGI talk into engineering targets — 'model capability must reach the industry's front rank' and 'push models toward the upper limits of intelligence' — while positioning AI as an industrial summit on par with PC, Web and Mobile, implicitly endorsing the scale of the general-intelligence opportunity. Hassabis publicly calling ByteDance 'China's strongest AI company' signals it has entered the global first-tier conversation.

openSource.summary: 字节是典型的“外围开源、核心闭源”：2025年8月开源Seed-OSS-36B（Apache-2.0、原生512K上下文），但量子位指出其命名呼应OpenAI gpt-oss——开源的是基于内部技术专门面向社区的版本，而非核心商业模型豆包。官方口径仅称“为开发者提供更丰富的选择”，领袖层几乎不谈开源理念。在多模态侧（Seedream图像、Seedance视频）字节靠产品力而非开放取胜，Seedance 2.0单月营收已超10亿元。开源对字节更像技术品牌的点缀，而非战略支柱。

quotes.text: 为开发者提供更丰富的选择。（Seed-OSS-36B开源官方表态）
quotes.textEn: Offering developers richer choices. (Official statement on open-sourcing Seed-OSS-36B)

openSource.summaryEn: ByteDance is the textbook 'open periphery, closed core': it open-sourced Seed-OSS-36B in August 2025 (Apache-2.0, native 512K context), but QbitAI notes the name echoes OpenAI's gpt-oss — what is open is a community-facing version built on internal tech, not the core commercial Doubao model. The official line is merely 'offering developers richer choices'; leadership barely discusses open-source philosophy. On multimodality (Seedream images, Seedance video) ByteDance wins on product strength rather than openness — Seedance 2.0 alone grossed over ¥1B in a month. For ByteDance, open source is a garnish on the tech brand, not a strategic pillar.

leader.name: 姜大昕
leader.bio: 前微软全球副总裁、微软亚太研发集团CTO（STCA），自然语言处理与搜索专家。2023年4月在上海创立阶跃星辰，两年内发布22款自研基座模型（16款多模态），提出“单模态→多模态→理解生成统一→世界模型→AGI”的技术路线图，2025年收敛聚焦Agent方向，与OPPO、吉利等合作智能终端。
leader.bioEn: Former Microsoft global VP and CTO of Microsoft Asia-Pacific R&D (STCA), an NLP and search expert. Founded StepFun in Shanghai in April 2023, releasing 22 self-developed foundation models in two years (16 multimodal). He proposed the roadmap 'single modality → multimodality → unified understanding-generation → world model → AGI', and in 2025 narrowed the focus to agents, partnering with OPPO, Geely and others on smart terminals.

strategy.summary: 阶跃星辰的战略是“多模态全覆盖”：成立两年发布22款基座模型，覆盖文字、语音、图像、视频、音乐、推理全系列，姜大昕坦然认领“多模态卷王”称号。2025年收敛聚焦Agent，与OPPO、吉利合作智能终端，并断言“DeepSeek证明投流模式不成立”，拒绝买量换增长。

quotes.text: 我认同‘多模态卷王’这个名字，我们的多模态布局是非常完整的。追求智能的上限仍然是当下最重要的一件事。
quotes.source: 媒体沟通会（科创板日报）
quotes.textEn: I accept the 'multimodal all-rounder' name — our multimodal layout is truly complete. Pursuing the upper limits of intelligence remains the most important thing right now.

strategy.summaryEn: StepFun's strategy is full multimodal coverage: 22 foundation models in two years spanning text, speech, image, video, music and reasoning — Jiang gladly accepts the 'multimodal all-rounder' label. In 2025 the company converged on agents, partnering with OPPO and Geely on smart terminals, and declared that 'DeepSeek proved the paid-traffic model doesn't work', refusing to buy growth.

agi.summary: 姜大昕把多模态视为通往AGI的必经之路：任何模态短板都会延缓AGI进程。其路线图分五级——单模态、多模态、理解生成统一、世界模型、AGI，坚持“原生多模态”，并直言“多模态目前还没有出现GPT-4时刻”，为下一代突破预留想象空间。

quotes.text: 我们认为多模态是实现AGI的必经之路……在多模态领域任何一个方向出现短板，都会延缓实现AGI的进程。
quotes.source: 媒体沟通会（科创板日报）
quotes.textEn: We believe multimodality is the necessary path to AGI... a weakness in any single modality direction will delay the arrival of AGI.

agi.summaryEn: Jiang sees multimodality as the necessary path to AGI: any modality weakness delays AGI. His five-level roadmap — single modality, multimodality, unified understanding-generation, world model, AGI — insists on native multimodality, and he notes plainly that 'multimodality hasn't had its GPT-4 moment yet', leaving room for the next breakthrough.

leader.name: 王小川
leader.bio: 清华大学计算机系毕业，搜狗创始人、前CEO，搜狗输入法/搜索/浏览器“三级火箭”设计者，2021年腾讯收购搜狗后离开创业。2023年4月创立百川智能，2025年初果断停止通用模型预训练、All in AI医疗；联合创始人相继离开后独自掌舵，提出“为人类造医生，为生命建模型”。
leader.bioEn: A Tsinghua CS graduate, founder and former CEO of Sogou, designer of the 'three-stage rocket' of Sogou Input/Search/Browser; left to start a new venture after Tencent acquired Sogou in 2021. Founded Baichuan Intelligence in April 2023; in early 2025 he decisively halted general-model pretraining to go all in on AI healthcare. After his co-founders departed one by one, he steers alone under the motto 'build doctors for humanity, build models for life.'

strategy.summary: 百川是“六小虎”中最决绝的转型样本：停止通用预训练、退GPU、裁撤行业线，团队精简过半，All in AI医疗。王小川的逻辑是反内卷：“继续卷通用模型，即使上市了很风光，焦虑也不会减少半分”；只要交付足够重要的价值，商业化水到渠成。两年后M4在HealthBench居全球第一。

quotes.text: 继续卷通用模型，走主流道路，那是一种选择，即使上市了很风光，但焦虑也不会减少半分。AI时代只要交付给用户足够重要的价值，商业化会是水到渠成的事。
quotes.textEn: Keep grinding general models on the mainstream path — that's one choice, but even a glamorous IPO wouldn't reduce the anxiety one bit. In the AI era, as long as you deliver sufficiently important value to users, commercialization comes naturally.

strategy.summaryEn: Baichuan is the most decisive pivot among the 'six tigers': it stopped general pretraining, returned GPUs, cut industry lines and more than half the team — all in on AI healthcare. Wang's logic is anti-involution: 'keep grinding general models and even a glamorous IPO won't reduce the anxiety one bit'; deliver sufficiently important value and commercialization follows naturally. Two years later, M4 ranked global #1 on HealthBench.

agi.summary: 王小川给AGI下了一个医学定义：“能够造出一个真正的医生，AGI就到来了。”他视医疗模型为“大模型皇冠上的明珠”，反对主流路线——“从第一天就不认同多模态是主战场”“符号才是智力的中轴”，把AGI命题收缩为垂直命题的务实哲学。

quotes.text: 医疗模型是大模型皇冠上的明珠。AI医疗的未来不是造工具，而是‘造AI医生’。能够造出一个真正的医生，AGI就到来了。
quotes.textEn: Medical models are the pearl on the crown of LLMs. The future of AI healthcare is not building tools — it is 'building AI doctors.' When we can build a real doctor, AGI will have arrived.

agi.summaryEn: Wang gives AGI a medical definition: 'when we can build a real doctor, AGI will have arrived.' He calls medical models 'the pearl on the crown of LLMs', and opposes the mainstream route — 'from day one I didn't buy multimodality as the main battlefield' and 'symbols are the axis of intelligence' — a pragmatic philosophy that shrinks the AGI question into a vertical one.

openSource.summary: 百川早期以Baichuan-7B/13B开源打开知名度，转型医疗后延续开放：M3开源发布、M4与清华联合发布。其开放服务于“评价体系共建”——联合顶尖医生与医疗机构建标准，而非争夺通用开源生态，开放是医疗共同体建设的手段。

quotes.text: 单纯有数据没用，关键是怎么用……核心是找顶尖的医生来帮我们建立一个‘评价体系’。
quotes.textEn: Data alone is useless; what matters is how you use it... The core is to bring in top doctors to help us build an 'evaluation system.'

openSource.summaryEn: Baichuan first made its name with the open-source Baichuan-7B/13B; after the healthcare pivot the openness continued — M3 was open-sourced and M4 was co-released with Tsinghua. Its openness serves 'co-building an evaluation system' with top doctors and medical institutions rather than competing for the general open-source ecosystem: openness is a means of building a medical community.

leader.name: Sam Altman（山姆·奥特曼）
leader.bio: 1985年生于芝加哥，斯坦福计算机系辍学。2005年联合创立Loopt（YC首批八家公司之一），2014年出任Y Combinator总裁。2015年12月与马斯克等共同创立OpenAI，2019年起全职任CEO；2023年11月经历“被解雇—复职”董事会风波后重组董事会。以密集的博客写作（《The Intelligence Age》《The Gentle Singularity》）定义了AGI时代的公共话语。

Wikimedia Commons：James Tamim摄肖像裁切版（CC BY 2.0）

leader.bioEn: Born in Chicago in 1985, Altman dropped out of Stanford CS. He co-founded Loopt in 2005 (one of YC's first eight companies) and became president of Y Combinator in 2014. He co-founded OpenAI with Elon Musk and others in December 2015, going full-time as CEO in 2019; after the November 2023 'fired and reinstated' board crisis he reconstituted the board. Through dense blog writing (The Intelligence Age, The Gentle Singularity) he has defined the public discourse of the AGI era.

strategy.summary: Altman治下的OpenAI战略是“全栈帝国”：底层是Stargate与“每周1吉瓦”的算力工厂愿景，中层是每4–6周迭代一次的GPT-5.x模型线，顶层是ChatGPT（即将成为最快达10亿周活的平台）、Codex智能体、Sora视频与Jony Ive操刀的AI硬件。他在参议院听证中毫不掩饰地缘立场——“希望全世界都用美国的技术栈”。商业化上，2026年3月完成1220亿美元史上最大私募轮（估值8520亿美元、月收入20亿美元），并完成非营利母体+公益公司架构重组，为最快2026下半年的IPO铺路。

quotes.text: We are now confident we know how to build AGI as we have traditionally understood it. ... In 2025, we may see the first AI agents 'join the workforce' and materially change the output of companies.
quotes.translation: 我们现在确信自己已经知道如何按传统定义构建AGI。……2025年，我们可能会看到第一批AI智能体“加入劳动力大军”，并实质性地改变企业产出。
quotes.textEn: We are now confident we know how to build AGI as we have traditionally understood it. ... In 2025, we may see the first AI agents 'join the workforce' and materially change the output of companies.

quotes.text: To me, the stack is, you know, from the chips at the bottom to the applications on the top, and we want the whole world on the U.S. stack. We want them to use U.S. chips. We want them to use services like ChatGPT.
quotes.translation: 在我看来，技术栈从底层的芯片一直到顶层的应用，我们希望全世界都用美国的技术栈。我们希望他们使用美国芯片，使用ChatGPT这样的服务。
quotes.source: 美国参议院商务委员会听证 Winning the AI Race
quotes.textEn: To me, the stack is, you know, from the chips at the bottom to the applications on the top, and we want the whole world on the U.S. stack. We want them to use U.S. chips. We want them to use services like ChatGPT.

quotes.text: Our vision is simple: we want to create a factory that can produce a gigawatt of new AI infrastructure every week.
quotes.translation: 我们的愿景很简单：建一座每周能生产1吉瓦新AI基础设施的工厂。
quotes.textEn: Our vision is simple: we want to create a factory that can produce a gigawatt of new AI infrastructure every week.

strategy.summaryEn: Under Altman, OpenAI's strategy is a full-stack empire: at the bottom, Stargate and the vision of 'a gigawatt of new AI infrastructure every week'; in the middle, the GPT-5.x line iterating every 4–6 weeks; on top, ChatGPT (on track to be the fastest platform to 1B weekly users), the Codex agent, Sora video and AI hardware with Jony Ive. He makes no secret of the geopolitical stance — telling the Senate he wants 'the whole world on the American tech stack.' Commercially, it closed the largest private round in history in March 2026 ($122B at an $852B valuation, $2B monthly revenue) and completed the nonprofit-parent + PBC restructuring, paving the way for an IPO as early as H2 2026.

agi.summary: Altman是全球AGI话语的定义者：2024年9月预言“几千天内”迎来超级智能，2025年1月宣布“确信知道如何构建AGI”，6月再以《温和的奇点》宣称“我们已经越过事件视界，起飞已经开始”——但奇点“远没有想象中那么怪异”，消解了末日叙事。他的时间表具体而渐进：2025年智能体做真实认知工作、2026年系统自主发现新洞见、2027年机器人进入物理世界。同时他把AI可及性抬升为“基本人权”，警告算力不足则AI将沦为“引发战争争夺、主要属于富人的工具”——为天量基建投资提供了道德合法性。

quotes.text: It is possible that we will have superintelligence in a few thousand days (!)... If we don't build enough infrastructure, AI will be a very limited resource that wars get fought over and that becomes mostly a tool for rich people.
quotes.translation: 我们有可能在几千天之内（！）迎来超级智能……如果我们不建设足够的基础设施，AI将成为一种极其稀缺的资源——引发战争争夺，并主要沦为富人的工具。
quotes.source: 个人博客 The Intelligence Age
quotes.textEn: It is possible that we will have superintelligence in a few thousand days (!)... If we don't build enough infrastructure, AI will be a very limited resource that wars get fought over and that becomes mostly a tool for rich people.

quotes.text: We are past the event horizon; the takeoff has started. Humanity is close to building digital superintelligence, and at least so far it's much less weird than it seems like it should be.
quotes.translation: 我们已经越过事件视界；起飞已经开始。人类已接近构建数字超级智能，而至少到目前为止，它远没有想象中那么怪异。
quotes.source: 个人博客 The Gentle Singularity
quotes.textEn: We are past the event horizon; the takeoff has started. Humanity is close to building digital superintelligence, and at least so far it's much less weird than it seems like it should be.

quotes.text: Access to AI will be a fundamental driver of the economy, and maybe eventually something we consider a fundamental human right.
quotes.translation: AI的可及性将成为经济的根本驱动力，甚至最终可能被视为一项基本人权。
quotes.textEn: Access to AI will be a fundamental driver of the economy, and maybe eventually something we consider a fundamental human right.

agi.summaryEn: Altman is the definer of global AGI discourse: in September 2024 he predicted superintelligence 'in a few thousand days'; in January 2025 he declared 'we are now confident we know how to build AGI'; in June, The Gentle Singularity claimed 'we have crossed the event horizon; the takeoff has begun' — while insisting the singularity is 'far less strange than imagined', defusing doomsday narratives. His timetable is concrete and gradual: agents doing real cognitive work in 2025, systems generating novel insights in 2026, robots entering the physical world in 2027. He has also elevated AI access to 'a fundamental human right', warning that without enough compute AI becomes 'a tool people fight wars over, mostly for the rich' — moral legitimacy for astronomical infrastructure spending.

openSource.summary: OpenAI的开源立场经历了历史性转弯。DeepSeek-R1冲击下，Altman在2025年1月的Reddit AMA中罕见认错：“我个人认为我们一直站在历史的错误一边”，并预言“领先优势将不如前些年那么大”。同年8月发布gpt-oss-120b/20b（Apache 2.0）——自GPT-2以来首次开放权重，并包装进地缘叙事：“由美国创造、以民主价值观为基础的开放AI技术栈”。但gpt-oss性能仅对标o4-mini，旗舰GPT-5.x依旧闭源，开放更多是生态防御与政治表态。

quotes.text: I personally think we have been on the wrong side of history here and need to figure out a different open source strategy. ... We will produce better models [going forward], but we will maintain less of a lead than we did in previous years.
quotes.translation: 我个人认为，在开源问题上我们一直站在历史的错误一边，需要制定一套不同的开源战略。……我们会做出更好的模型，但领先优势将不如前些年那么大。
quotes.textEn: I personally think we have been on the wrong side of history here and need to figure out a different open source strategy. ... We will produce better models [going forward], but we will maintain less of a lead than we did in previous years.

quotes.text: gpt-oss is out! we made an open model that performs at the level of o4-mini and runs on a high-end laptop (WTF!!) (and a smaller one that runs on a phone). super proud of the team; big triumph of technology.
quotes.translation: gpt-oss发布了！我们做了一款性能达到o4-mini水平、能跑在高端笔记本上的开放模型（不可思议！！）（还有一款能跑在手机上的小模型）。为团队超级自豪；这是技术的重大胜利。
quotes.textEn: gpt-oss is out! we made an open model that performs at the level of o4-mini and runs on a high-end laptop (WTF!!) (and a smaller one that runs on a phone). super proud of the team; big triumph of technology.

quotes.text: We're excited to ... [build an] open AI stack created in the United States, based on democratic values ...
quotes.translation: 我们很兴奋……（让世界）基于一个由美国创造、以民主价值观为基础的开放AI技术栈来构建……
quotes.textEn: We're excited to ... [build an] open AI stack created in the United States, based on democratic values ...

openSource.summaryEn: OpenAI's open-source stance made a historic U-turn. Under the shock of DeepSeek-R1, Altman admitted in a January 2025 Reddit AMA: 'I personally think we have been on the wrong side of history here', and predicted its lead 'would not be as great as in prior years.' In August it released gpt-oss-120b/20b (Apache 2.0) — the first open weights since GPT-2 — wrapped in geopolitical framing: 'an open AI stack created in America, based on democratic values.' But gpt-oss only matches o4-mini-class performance; the flagship GPT-5.x remains closed. Openness here is ecosystem defense and political signaling.

leader.name: Dario Amodei（达里奥·阿莫迪）
leader.bio: 1983年生于旧金山，普林斯顿生物物理学博士、斯坦福医学院博士后。曾任职百度硅谷AI实验室与Google Brain，2016年加入OpenAI任研究副总裁，主导GPT-2/GPT-3研发；2020年底因AI安全路线分歧离开，2021年1月与妹妹Daniela及五名前OpenAI同事创立Anthropic。公众形象是“安全优先”的标志性CEO：既高调警告就业冲击与失控风险，又在《Machines of Loving Grace》中系统阐述乐观愿景。

Wikimedia Commons：TechCrunch Disrupt 2023演讲照（CC BY 2.0）

leader.bioEn: Born in San Francisco in 1983; Princeton PhD in biophysics and Stanford School of Medicine postdoc. After stints at Baidu's Silicon Valley AI lab and Google Brain, he joined OpenAI in 2016 as VP of Research, leading GPT-2/GPT-3 development; he left in late 2020 over AI-safety disagreements and founded Anthropic in January 2021 with his sister Daniela and five former OpenAI colleagues. His public image is the signature 'safety-first' CEO: warning loudly about job disruption and loss-of-control risks while laying out an optimistic vision in Machines of Loving Grace.

strategy.summary: Anthropic的战略是“安全即护城河”：以安全、可解释性、对齐研究为先导，把“负责任”做成企业级市场的通行证——约80–85%收入来自企业与开发者，2025年底占企业LLM支出40%，年化收入运行率达470亿美元。Amodei把公司定位为“给AI实验装上保险杠”：Claude 4.x系列霸榜LMArena、SWE-bench双榜第一，Claude Code成为智能体编程事实标准；Mythos级模型因发现数千0day漏洞仅限受信伙伴。2026年6月保密提交S-1，可能抢在OpenAI之前IPO。

quotes.text: I think it is an experiment. And one way to think about Anthropic is that it's a little bit trying to put bumpers or guardrails on that experiment.
quotes.translation: 我认为这（AI）是一场实验。理解Anthropic的一种方式是：它试图给这场实验装上保险杠或护栏。
quotes.textEn: I think it is an experiment. And one way to think about Anthropic is that it's a little bit trying to put bumpers or guardrails on that experiment.

quotes.text: We can't stop the bus, but we can steer it.
quotes.translation: 我们无法让大巴停下，但我们可以掌舵。
quotes.source: 博客 The Urgency of Interpretability
quotes.textEn: We can't stop the bus, but we can steer it.

quotes.text: Many of the implications of powerful AI are adversarial or dangerous, but at the end of it all, there has to be something we're fighting for, some positive-sum outcome where everyone is better off.
quotes.translation: 强大AI的许多影响是对抗性甚至危险的，但归根结底，必须有某种我们为之奋斗的东西——一个人人都变得更好的正和结果。
quotes.source: 博客长文 Machines of Loving Grace
quotes.textEn: Many of the implications of powerful AI are adversarial or dangerous, but at the end of it all, there has to be something we're fighting for, some positive-sum outcome where everyone is better off.

strategy.summaryEn: Anthropic's strategy is safety-as-moat: leading with safety, interpretability and alignment research, turning 'responsible' into an enterprise passport — roughly 80–85% of revenue comes from enterprises and developers, about 40% of enterprise LLM spend by end-2025, with annualized revenue run-rate of $47B. Amodei positions the company as 'putting bumpers on the AI experiment': the Claude 4.x family tops both LMArena and SWE-bench, Claude Code has become the de-facto standard for agentic coding, and Mythos-class models are restricted to trusted partners after discovering thousands of 0-day vulnerabilities. It confidentially filed an S-1 in June 2026 and may IPO ahead of OpenAI.

agi.summary: Amodei不谈“AGI”而谈“强大AI”：一个“数据中心里的天才之国”——在生物、编程、数学等大多数领域比诺奖得主更聪明的系统，他认为可能在2026–2027年到来。他的独特之处在于同时放大两端：多数人既低估上行空间有多激进，也低估风险有多糟糕。因此他一边写《Machines of Loving Grace》描绘“压缩的21世纪”，一边警告AI可能消灭一半初级白领岗位，并在60 Minutes承认“没有人选举我们”。2026年的《技术的青春期》把AGI到来定义为“动荡而不可避免的成人礼”。

quotes.text: In terms of pure intelligence, it is smarter than a Nobel Prize winner across most relevant fields: biology, programming, math, engineering, writing, etc... We could summarize this as a 'country of geniuses in a datacenter.'
quotes.translation: 就纯智能而言，它在大多数相关领域（生物、编程、数学、工程、写作等）比诺贝尔奖得主更聪明……我们可以把它概括为“数据中心里的天才之国”。
quotes.source: 博客长文 Machines of Loving Grace
quotes.textEn: In terms of pure intelligence, it is smarter than a Nobel Prize winner across most relevant fields: biology, programming, math, engineering, writing, etc... We could summarize this as a 'country of geniuses in a datacenter.'

quotes.text: AI could wipe out half of all entry-level white-collar jobs — and spike unemployment to 10-20% in the next one to five years.
quotes.translation: AI可能消灭一半初级白领岗位，并在未来一到五年内把失业率推高到10%–20%。
quotes.source: Axios 专访 Behind the Curtain
quotes.textEn: AI could wipe out half of all entry-level white-collar jobs — and spike unemployment to 10-20% in the next one to five years.

quotes.text: I believe we are entering a rite of passage, both turbulent and inevitable, which will test who we are as a species.
quotes.translation: 我相信我们正在进入一场成人礼，它动荡而不可避免，将考验我们这个物种的成色。
quotes.source: 博客长文 The Adolescence of Technology
quotes.textEn: I believe we are entering a rite of passage, both turbulent and inevitable, which will test who we are as a species.

agi.summaryEn: Amodei speaks not of 'AGI' but of 'powerful AI': a 'country of geniuses in a datacenter' — systems smarter than Nobel laureates across biology, coding, math and most fields, which he believes may arrive in 2026–2027. His signature is amplifying both ends at once: most people underestimate both how radical the upside is and how bad the risks are. So he writes Machines of Loving Grace to depict a 'compressed 21st century' while warning AI could eliminate half of entry-level white-collar jobs, admitting on 60 Minutes that 'no one elected us.' His 2026 essay The Adolescence of Technology frames AGI's arrival as a turbulent but inevitable rite of passage.

openSource.summary: Anthropic是头部实验室中最坚定的闭源派。Amodei认为“开源在AI领域不成立”：开源软件能看到源代码，但模型权重不可检视，应称“开放权重”而非开源，众人协作的开源红利在AI上并不成立；他甚至把“是否开源”称为伪命题——唯一该问的是“它是不是好模型”。其2023年参议院证词更警告开源前沿模型正走向“非常危险的道路”：权重一旦公开即不可召回。唯一的例外是把MCP开放为行业标准——开放协议、闭源模型，是其精确的边界。

quotes.text: I don't think open source works the same way in AI that it has worked in other areas, primarily because with open source you can see the source code of the model — here we can't see inside the model. It's often called open weights instead of open source...
quotes.translation: 我不认为开源在AI领域能像在其它领域那样运作，主要原因在于：开源软件你能看到源代码，但在这里我们看不到模型内部。所以它常被称为“开放权重”而非“开源”……
quotes.textEn: I don't think open source works the same way in AI that it has worked in other areas, primarily because with open source you can see the source code of the model — here we can't see inside the model. It's often called open weights instead of open source...

quotes.text: I've actually always seen it as a red herring when I see a new model come out. I don't care whether it's open source or not... I ask, is it a good model? Is it better than us at the things that — that's the only thing that I care about.
quotes.translation: 每当新模型发布，我一直认为“是否开源”是个伪命题。我不在乎它开不开源……我只问：它是不是好模型？在关键能力上是否比我们强？这才是我唯一在乎的。
quotes.textEn: I've actually always seen it as a red herring when I see a new model come out. I don't care whether it's open source or not... I ask, is it a good model? Is it better than us at the things that — that's the only thing that I care about.

quotes.text: I think [DeepSeek's releases] make export control policies even more existentially important than they were a week ago... Well-enforced export controls are the only thing that can prevent China from getting millions of chips.
quotes.translation: 我认为（DeepSeek的发布）让出口管制政策比一周前更加生死攸关……执行良好的出口管制是阻止中国获得数百万块芯片的唯一手段。
quotes.source: 博客 On DeepSeek and Export Controls
quotes.textEn: I think [DeepSeek's releases] make export control policies even more existentially important than they were a week ago... Well-enforced export controls are the only thing that can prevent China from getting millions of chips.

openSource.summaryEn: Anthropic is the most firmly closed frontier lab. Amodei argues 'open source doesn't apply to AI': with software you can inspect the source, but model weights are not inspectable — they should be called 'open weights', and the collaborative dividend of open source doesn't hold for AI. He even calls the open-vs-closed question a red herring — the only question is 'is it a good model?' His 2023 Senate testimony warned that open-sourcing frontier models heads down 'a very dangerous path': once weights are public they cannot be recalled. The sole exception is open-sourcing MCP as an industry standard — open protocols, closed models: a precisely drawn boundary.

leader.name: Demis Hassabis（戴密斯·哈萨比斯）
leader.bio: 1976年生于伦敦，国际象棋神童，17岁参与设计经典游戏《Theme Park》；剑桥计算机科学双重一等荣誉，UCL认知神经科学博士。2010年联合创立DeepMind，主导AlphaGo与AlphaFold，2023年起任合并后的Google DeepMind CEO，兼Isomorphic Labs CEO。2024年获诺贝尔化学奖并封爵，是“AI for Science”路线的旗帜人物。

photos.source: Wikimedia Commons：2024诺贝尔奖周斯德哥尔摩记者会近景肖像（CC BY-SA 4.0）
Wikimedia Commons：2025年Christopher Michel摄超高清肖像（CC BY-SA 4.0，浏览器渲染验证）

leader.bioEn: Born in London in 1976, a chess prodigy who co-designed the classic game Theme Park at 17; double first in CS from Cambridge, PhD in cognitive neuroscience from UCL. Co-founded DeepMind in 2010, led AlphaGo and AlphaFold, and has been CEO of the merged Google DeepMind since 2023, also CEO of Isomorphic Labs. Winner of the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry and a knighthood — the flag-bearer of the 'AI for Science' route.

strategy.summary: Google DeepMind的战略是“研究×产品的双重整合”：一边追求“通用AI助手”愿景——Gemini发布当天即进入搜索与Antigravity平台，以Google的规模分发（应用月活6.5亿+）；一边坚守“AI for Science”——AlphaFold数据库免费供全球超200万研究者使用。背靠Alphabet每年1750–1850亿美元的AI资本开支，它是唯一能与OpenAI在算力上正面对抗的机构。但2026年也暴露隐忧：Gemini 3.5 Pro两度延期引发千亿美元级市值波动，核心人才被对手挖角。

quotes.text: Our recent updates to Gemini are critical steps towards unlocking our vision for a universal AI assistant, one that's helpful in your everyday life, that's intelligent and understands the context you're in, and that can plan and take actions on your behalf across any device.
quotes.translation: 我们近期对Gemini的更新，是通往“通用AI助手”愿景的关键步骤——它有益于你的日常生活，足够智能、理解你所处的情境，并能跨任何设备替你规划和行动。
quotes.textEn: Our recent updates to Gemini are critical steps towards unlocking our vision for a universal AI assistant, one that's helpful in your everyday life, that's intelligent and understands the context you're in, and that can plan and take actions on your behalf across any device.

quotes.text: AI is the most profound technology humanity will ever work on. It'll be more profound than fire or electricity... It's recursively self-improving; it's capable of that. It's the first technology that will dramatically accelerate creation itself.
quotes.translation: AI将是人类研究过的最深远的技术，比火或电更深远……它能够递归式自我改进；它是第一项能显著加速“创造”本身的技术。
quotes.textEn: AI is the most profound technology humanity will ever work on. It'll be more profound than fire or electricity... It's recursively self-improving; it's capable of that. It's the first technology that will dramatically accelerate creation itself.

quotes.text: And now we're introducing Gemini 3, our most intelligent model... starting today, we're shipping Gemini at the scale of Google... This is the first time we are shipping Gemini in Search on day one.
quotes.translation: 今天我们发布Gemini 3——我们最智能的模型……从今天开始以Google的规模交付……这是第一次新Gemini在发布当天就进入搜索。
quotes.textEn: And now we're introducing Gemini 3, our most intelligent model... starting today, we're shipping Gemini at the scale of Google... This is the first time we are shipping Gemini in Search on day one.

strategy.summaryEn: Google DeepMind's strategy is research × product double integration: pursuing the 'universal AI assistant' vision — Gemini entered Search and the Antigravity platform on launch day, distributed at Google scale (650M+ app MAU) — while holding the 'AI for Science' line, with the AlphaFold database free for 2M+ researchers worldwide. Backed by Alphabet's $175–185B annual AI capex, it is the only organization that can fight OpenAI head-on on compute. But 2026 exposed anxieties: Gemini 3.5 Pro slipped twice, swinging market value by hundreds of billions, and core talent was poached by rivals.

agi.summary: Hassabis是AGI时间表上的“谨慎乐观派”：能匹敌人类任何任务的AI将在5–10年内到来，2030年前概率约50%，且仍差1–2个关键突破（持续学习、世界模型）——比Altman和Amodei的叙事都克制。他的使命感根植于科学：AGI的终极意义是成为“帮助科学家的终极工具”，AlphaFold只是第一个范例。对影响量级他毫不含糊：AI将如工业革命“但可能大10倍、快10倍”，既带来“激进丰裕”也伴随巨大动荡；回望此刻，“我们正站在奇点的山脚下”。

quotes.text: AI that can match humans at any task will be here in five to 10 years.
quotes.translation: 能在任何任务上匹敌人类的AI，将在5到10年内到来。
quotes.textEn: AI that can match humans at any task will be here in five to 10 years.

quotes.text: I've got a probability distribution around the timings, but I would say there's a very good chance of [AGI arrival] being within the next five years.
quotes.translation: 我对时间点有一个概率分布，但我会说（AGI）在未来五年内到来的可能性非常大。
quotes.textEn: I've got a probability distribution around the timings, but I would say there's a very good chance of [AGI arrival] being within the next five years.

quotes.text: I think [AI is] going to be like the industrial revolution, but maybe 10 times bigger, 10 times faster. So it's an incredible amount of transformation, but also disruption that's going to happen.
quotes.translation: 我认为（AI）会像工业革命一样，但可能大10倍、快10倍。这将带来难以置信的变革，同时也伴随着巨大的动荡。
quotes.source: CNBC播客 The Tech Download（Global Advisors引述）
quotes.textEn: I think [AI is] going to be like the industrial revolution, but maybe 10 times bigger, 10 times faster. So it's an incredible amount of transformation, but also disruption that's going to happen.

agi.summaryEn: Hassabis is the cautious optimist on AGI timelines: AI matching humans at any task arrives within 5–10 years, ~50% probability by 2030, still needing 1–2 key breakthroughs (continual learning, world models) — more restrained than Altman's or Amodei's narratives. His mission is rooted in science: AGI's ultimate meaning is to be 'the ultimate tool for scientists', with AlphaFold as the first example. On magnitude he is unambiguous: AI will be like the Industrial Revolution 'but maybe 10 times bigger and 10 times faster', bringing both 'radical abundance' and great turbulence; in hindsight, 'we stand at the foothills of the singularity.'

openSource.summary: Google采取“旗舰闭源+战略性开放”的双轨：前沿Gemini闭源并以Frontier Safety Framework分级管控；同时以Gemma开放模型家族（与Gemini同源技术）抓住开发者与端侧生态，Gemma 4 31B已进入LMArena前30，回应Llama与DeepSeek阵营。更具独特性的是科学开放：AlphaFold数据库免费向全球研究者开放、超200万人使用，把“开放”做成科学公共品而非商业筹码。Hassabis把AlphaFold定义为AI加速科学发现新范式的第一个范例。

quotes.text: Let's shift gears and talk about Gemma, our family of open models, which are crucial for driving AI innovation and responsibility. Gemma is being built from the same research and technology as Gemini.
quotes.translation: 现在换个话题，谈谈Gemma——我们的开放模型家族，它对推动AI创新与责任至关重要。Gemma正是用与Gemini相同的研究和技术构建的。
quotes.textEn: Let's shift gears and talk about Gemma, our family of open models, which are crucial for driving AI innovation and responsibility. Gemma is being built from the same research and technology as Gemini.

quotes.text: The reason I've worked on AI my whole life is that I'm passionate about science... If we could build AI in the right way, it could be the ultimate tool to help scientists. I hope AlphaFold is a first example of that.
quotes.translation: 我毕生投身AI的原因是我热爱科学……如果我们能以正确的方式构建AI，它将成为帮助科学家的终极工具。我希望AlphaFold是这方面的第一个范例。
quotes.textEn: The reason I've worked on AI my whole life is that I'm passionate about science... If we could build AI in the right way, it could be the ultimate tool to help scientists. I hope AlphaFold is a first example of that.

openSource.summaryEn: Google runs a dual track of closed flagship + strategic openness: frontier Gemini stays closed under the tiered Frontier Safety Framework, while the Gemma open-model family (built on Gemini technology) captures developers and on-device ecosystems — Gemma 4 31B has entered LMArena's top 30, answering the Llama and DeepSeek camps. Uniquely, there is scientific openness: the AlphaFold database is free for researchers worldwide, used by over 2 million — openness as a scientific public good rather than a commercial chip. Hassabis defines AlphaFold as the first example of a new paradigm of AI-accelerated scientific discovery.

leader.name: Mark Zuckerberg（马克·扎克伯格）
leader.bio: 1984年生，哈佛辍学创立Facebook，将Meta打造成全球最大社交公司。2024年发表《开源AI是前进之路》宣言，2025年起亲自发动“亿元薪酬”人才战：143亿美元投资Scale AI并挖来Alexandr Wang任首位首席AI官，组建Meta超级智能实验室（MSL），任命OpenAI o1核心研究者赵晟佳为首席科学家，宣布投入数千亿美元建设Prometheus/Hyperion超算集群。

In 2024 he published the manifesto 'Open Source AI Is the Path Forward'; from 2025 he personally launched a hundred-million-dollar talent war — investing $14.3B in Scale AI and poaching Alexandr Wang as its first Chief AI Officer, forming Meta Superintelligence Labs (MSL) with OpenAI o1 core researcher Zhao Shengjia as chief scientist, and pledging hundreds of billions for the Prometheus/Hyperion supercomputing clusters.

companies.flagshipModel: Llama 5（开源权重）/ Muse Spark（闭源）

strategy.summary: Zuckerberg的AI战略是“用钱买时间”的极限版本：143亿美元入股Scale AI换来Alexandr Wang任首位首席AI官，以高达1–3亿美元的薪酬包从OpenAI、Google、Apple成建制挖角，组建超级智能实验室（MSL）；同时宣布投入数千亿美元建设Prometheus与Hyperion数据中心。其愿景区别于同行的“中心化自动化”——他要的是“个人超级智能”，载体是能看你所看、听你所听的智能眼镜。但2026年中他承认进展“低于预期”，只给出3–6个月窗口。

quotes.text: This is distinct from others in the industry who believe superintelligence should be directed centrally towards automating all valuable work, and then humanity will live on a dole of its output.
quotes.translation: 这不同于行业内另一些人的观点——他们认为超级智能应被集中导向自动化一切有价值的工作，然后人类靠其产出的救济过活。
quotes.source: 个人超级智能公开信（SiliconANGLE等）
quotes.textEn: This is distinct from others in the industry who believe superintelligence should be directed centrally towards automating all valuable work, and then humanity will live on a dole of its output.

quotes.text: Personal devices like glasses that understand our context because they can see what we see, hear what we hear, and interact with us throughout the day will become our primary computing devices.
quotes.translation: 像眼镜这样能看见我们所见、听见我们所闻、全天与我们互动的个人设备，将成为我们的主要计算设备。
quotes.source: 个人超级智能公开信（CBS News）
quotes.textEn: Personal devices like glasses that understand our context because they can see what we see, hear what we hear, and interact with us throughout the day will become our primary computing devices.

quotes.text: 我们将投资数百亿美元于超级智能，因为这是通往未来的钥匙。（财报电话会，中文转述）
quotes.textEn: We will invest hundreds of billions of dollars in superintelligence, because it is the key to the future. (Earnings call, translated from Chinese)

strategy.summaryEn: Zuckerberg's AI strategy is 'buying time with money' taken to the extreme: a $14.3B stake in Scale AI brought Alexandr Wang in as the first Chief AI Officer; compensation packages of up to $100–300M poached whole teams from OpenAI, Google and Apple to form Meta Superintelligence Labs (MSL); and he pledged hundreds of billions for the Prometheus and Hyperion data centers. His vision differs from rivals' 'centralized automation' — he wants 'personal superintelligence', carried by smart glasses that see what you see and hear what you hear. But in mid-2026 he admitted progress was 'below expectations', giving only a 3–6 month window.

agi.summary: Zuckerberg把AGI话语换成了“超级智能”，并在2025年7月公开信中宣称已看到曙光：AI系统开始自我改进，“改进目前缓慢，但不可否认”。他把本十年剩余时间定义为决定技术走向的“决定性时期”。与Altman的奇点叙事、Amodei的天才之国不同，他的超级智能高度个人化——核心场景是智能眼镜成为主要计算设备、AI理解每个人的日常情境。这一愿景服务于Meta的产品基因（社交+硬件），也让其在“超级智能用来做什么”的辩论中与OpenAI的“自动化一切”划清界限。

quotes.text: Over the last few months we have begun to see glimpses of our AI systems improving themselves. The improvement is slow for now, but undeniable. Developing superintelligence is now in sight.
quotes.translation: 过去几个月，我们开始看到我们的AI系统开始自我改进的曙光。这一改进目前缓慢，但不可否认。开发超级智能现在已经看到了曙光。
quotes.source: 个人超级智能公开信+Q2财报电话会
quotes.textEn: Over the last few months we have begun to see glimpses of our AI systems improving themselves. The improvement is slow for now, but undeniable. Developing superintelligence is now in sight.

quotes.text: The rest of this decade seems likely to be the decisive period for determining the path this technology will take.
quotes.translation: 本十年的剩余时间很可能将决定这项技术走向何方的决定性时期。
quotes.textEn: The rest of this decade seems likely to be the decisive period for determining the path this technology will take.

agi.summaryEn: Zuckerberg swapped AGI talk for 'superintelligence', declaring in his July 2025 open letter that it is now in sight: AI systems have begun improving themselves — 'slowly for now, but undeniably.' He calls the rest of this decade the 'decisive period' for the technology's direction. Unlike Altman's singularity or Amodei's country of geniuses, his superintelligence is highly personal — the core scenario is smart glasses becoming the primary computing device, with AI understanding each person's daily context. The vision serves Meta's product DNA (social + hardware) and draws a line against OpenAI's 'automate everything' in the debate over what superintelligence is for.

openSource.summary: Meta曾是开源阵营的最大旗手：2024年7月随Llama 3.1 405B发表宣言《开源AI是前进之路》，称开源AI是“为每个人创造最大经济机会与安全保障的最佳途径”。但Llama 4反响平淡、中国开源力量崛起后立场回摆：以“前所未有的安全顾虑”为由“谨慎选择开源什么”，2026年4月起形成双轨——Llama 5继续开放权重、前沿Muse Spark闭源。The Register讥讽其“像Zuckerberg的私立学校一样开放”，标志Meta退向实用主义。

quotes.text: Open source AI represents the world's best shot at harnessing this technology to create the greatest economic opportunity and security for everyone.
quotes.translation: 开源AI是全世界利用这项技术为每个人创造最大经济机会与安全保障的最佳途径。
quotes.source: 公开信 Open Source AI is the Path Forward（随Llama 3.1 405B发布）
quotes.textEn: Open source AI represents the world's best shot at harnessing this technology to create the greatest economic opportunity and security for everyone.

quotes.text: If we were the only company using Llama, this ecosystem wouldn't develop and we'd fare no better than the closed variants of Unix.
quotes.translation: 如果只有Meta一家在用Llama，这个生态就不会发展起来，我们的下场不会比封闭版的Unix更好。
quotes.source: 公开信 Open Source AI is the Path Forward
quotes.textEn: If we were the only company using Llama, this ecosystem wouldn't develop and we'd fare no better than the closed variants of Unix.

quotes.text: Looking ahead, we plan to release increasingly advanced models that push the frontier of intelligence and capabilities, including new open source models.
quotes.translation: 展望未来，我们计划发布不断突破智能与能力边界的更先进模型，包括新的开源模型。
quotes.textEn: Looking ahead, we plan to release increasingly advanced models that push the frontier of intelligence and capabilities, including new open source models.

openSource.summaryEn: Meta was once open source's biggest champion: in July 2024, alongside Llama 3.1 405B, it published the manifesto 'Open Source AI Is the Path Forward', calling open-source AI 'the best way to create the greatest economic opportunity and security for everyone.' But after Llama 4's lukewarm reception and the rise of Chinese open-source players, the stance swung back: citing 'unprecedented safety concerns', it now 'carefully chooses what to open-source' — since April 2026 a dual track: Llama 5 stays open-weight while the frontier Muse Spark is closed. The Register mocked it as 'as open as Zuckerberg's private school' — Meta has retreated to pragmatism.

leader.name: Elon Musk（埃隆·马斯克）
leader.bio: 1971年生，Tesla、SpaceX、X（原Twitter）掌舵者，OpenAI联合创始人之一（2018年退出）。2023年3月注册xAI、7月12日对外亮相（日期致敬《银河系漫游指南》的“42”），使命定为“理解宇宙的真实本质”。以“最大求真”“反觉醒”为Grok的差异化定位，2026年2月将xAI并入SpaceX，承认“xAI起初并没有被很好地构建，目前正在重建”。
leader.bioEn: Born in 1971, Musk leads Tesla, SpaceX and X (formerly Twitter), and was an OpenAI co-founder (departed 2018). He registered xAI in March 2023 and unveiled it on July 12 (a nod to '42' from The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy), with the mission 'to understand the true nature of the universe.' Grok differentiates on 'maximum truth-seeking' and being 'anti-woke.' In February 2026 xAI merged into SpaceX; Musk admitted 'xAI was not built very well at the start and is now being rebuilt.'

strategy.summary: xAI的战略是“数据+算力的暴力美学”：一手握有X平台这一“世界上最好的实时数据来源”，一手在孟菲斯堆出约55.5万块GPU、2GW容量的Colossus超算，用规模直接换取模型能力。Grok以“最大求真”“反觉醒”区隔竞品，深度嵌入X生态（月活约1.17亿，美国聊天机器人份额一年内从1.9%升至17.8%）。但2026年公司剧烈动荡：11名联合创始研究员中9人离职，Musk承认“xAI起初并没有被很好地构建”；2月被SpaceX收购、7月更名SpaceXAI，前沿三强中估值最小但营收倍数最高。

quotes.text: We've got the X system, formerly the Twitter system, which is by far the best source of real-time data in the world.
quotes.translation: 我们拥有X系统（原Twitter），这是迄今为止世界上最好的实时数据来源。
quotes.textEn: We've got the X system, formerly the Twitter system, which is by far the best source of real-time data in the world.

quotes.text: This is the smartest AI in the world, and we're going to show you exactly how and why… Grok 4 is smarter than almost all graduate students in all disciplines simultaneously.
quotes.translation: 这是全世界最聪明的AI，我们将向你们展示它究竟如何、为何如此……Grok 4在所有学科上同时比几乎所有研究生都聪明。
quotes.textEn: This is the smartest AI in the world, and we're going to show you exactly how and why… Grok 4 is smarter than almost all graduate students in all disciplines simultaneously.

quotes.text: xAI 起初并没有被很好地构建，目前正在重建。（"xAI was not built very well at the start, and is currently being rebuilt."）
quotes.textEn: xAI was not built very well at the start, and is now being rebuilt.

strategy.summaryEn: xAI's strategy is brute-force aesthetics of data + compute: one hand holds the X platform — 'the world's best real-time data source' — the other has stacked ~555K GPUs and 2GW of capacity at the Colossus supercomputer in Memphis, trading raw scale directly for model capability. Grok differentiates with 'maximum truth-seeking' and 'anti-woke' positioning, deeply embedded in the X ecosystem (~117M MAU; its US chatbot share rose from 1.9% to 17.8% in a year). But 2026 brought violent turbulence: 9 of 11 co-founding researchers left, Musk admitted 'xAI was not built very well at the start'; it was acquired by SpaceX in February and renamed SpaceXAI in July — the smallest valuation but the highest revenue multiple among the frontier three.

agi.summary: Musk对AGI的表述既狂妄又坦白：他预言Grok 5“有10%的概率成为全球首个AGI”——特意强调“机会不是零，但也不算高”；同时在内部宣称“挺过未来两三年就能战胜竞争对手，最早2026年实现AGI”。其AGI方法论有二：实时数据——“做不到理解实时视频，反正也无法实现AGI”；规模——Grok 5规划6万亿参数、150万token上下文。他还放话Grok“明年可能发现新物理”。这些言论置信度不一，但完整呈现了其“先夸大、再兑现”的一贯节奏。

quotes.text: Grok 5 is the first time where I thought, well, we have a non-zero chance of achieving artificial general intelligence, not that it's a high chance.
quotes.translation: Grok 5是第一次让我觉得，嗯，我们实现通用人工智能的机会不是零——尽管这个机会也不算高。
quotes.textEn: Grok 5 is the first time where I thought, well, we have a non-zero chance of achieving artificial general intelligence, not that it's a high chance.

quotes.text: If you can't [understand real-time video]… you really can't achieve AGI anyway.
quotes.translation: 如果做不到（理解实时视频）……那你反正也无法实现AGI。
quotes.textEn: If you can't [understand real-time video]… you really can't achieve AGI anyway.

quotes.text: 只要公司能顺利挺过未来两到三年，xAI 就能战胜竞争对手……xAI 有可能在未来几年内实现 AGI，甚至最早可能在 2026 年。（全员大会内部讲话，知情人士转述）
quotes.textEn: As long as the company gets through the next two to three years, xAI can beat its competitors... xAI could achieve AGI as early as 2026. (Internal all-hands, translated from Chinese)

agi.summaryEn: Musk's AGI talk is both audacious and candid: he predicts Grok 5 has 'a 10% chance of becoming the world's first AGI' — pointedly noting 'the odds are not zero, but not high either' — while internally claiming that surviving the next two or three years means beating the competition, with AGI as early as 2026. His AGI methodology has two pillars: real-time data — 'if you can't understand real-time video, you can't achieve AGI anyway' — and scale: Grok 5 is planned at 6 trillion parameters with 1.5M-token context. He has even claimed Grok 'might discover new physics next year.' Confidence levels vary, but together they show his trademark rhythm: exaggerate first, deliver later.

openSource.summary: xAI的开源是“滞后开源”：2024年3月将314B参数的Grok-1以Apache 2.0开源，官方称“我们以Apache 2.0许可发布权重与架构”；2025年8月开源Grok-2.5并计划半年后开源Grok-3，但改用带反竞争条款的定制社区许可，被评论为“有限度的开放”；Grok 4及之后模型均为闭源。理念层面，Musk多次抨击OpenAI背离开源使命——“Open在OpenAI中的含义正是开源”，主张代码透明可增强公众信任；但落到自家身上，开源始终是落后一代的营销工具，而非核心承诺。

quotes.text: We are releasing the weights and the architecture under the Apache 2.0 license.
quotes.translation: 我们以Apache 2.0许可发布权重与架构。
quotes.textEn: We are releasing the weights and the architecture under the Apache 2.0 license.

quotes.text: Open 在 OpenAI 中的含义正是开源。（Musk多次抨击OpenAI背离开源使命，主张代码透明可增强公众信任）
quotes.textEn: The 'Open' in OpenAI was supposed to mean open source. (Musk has repeatedly attacked OpenAI for betraying its open-source mission; translated from Chinese)

openSource.summaryEn: xAI's open source is 'lagged open-sourcing': in March 2024 it released the 314B-parameter Grok-1 under Apache 2.0 — 'we are releasing the weights and architecture under Apache 2.0' — and in August 2025 it open-sourced Grok-2.5, promising Grok-3 six months later, but switched to a custom community license with anti-compete clauses, criticized as 'limited openness.' Grok 4 and later are closed. Philosophically, Musk has repeatedly attacked OpenAI for betraying its open-source mission — 'the Open in OpenAI was supposed to mean open source' — arguing transparent code builds public trust; but at home, open source remains a marketing tool for last-generation models, not a core commitment.

leader.name: Arthur Mensch（亚瑟·门施）
leader.bio: 前Google DeepMind研究员，2023年4月与前Meta AI的Guillaume Lample、Timothée Lacroix在巴黎创立Mistral AI，种子轮即融1.05亿欧元创欧洲纪录。以开放权重路线与欧洲AI主权代言人身份著称，达沃斯放话“Mistral is not for sale”，IPO为既定路线；2025年联合英伟达启动Mistral Compute欧洲主权算力项目，被马克龙称为“历史性”。
leader.bioEn: A former Google DeepMind researcher, Mensch founded Mistral AI in Paris in April 2023 with Guillaume Lample and Timothée Lacroix (ex-Meta AI), raising a record €105M seed round. Known for the open-weights route and as the voice of European AI sovereignty, he declared at Davos that 'Mistral is not for sale', with an IPO as the stated path; in 2025 he launched the Mistral Compute sovereign-AI infrastructure project with NVIDIA.

strategy.summary: Mistral的战略是“欧洲主权+企业落地”：在美中两面挤压下转向“Palantir式”驻场企业AI服务，客户含汇丰及多国政府；联合英伟达启动Mistral Compute主权算力项目。Mensch在达沃斯明确“Mistral不卖”，IPO是既定路线。

quotes.text: Mistral is not for sale.
quotes.translation: Mistral不卖。
quotes.source: 达沃斯世界经济论坛（Paperjam等报道）
quotes.textEn: Mistral is not for sale.

strategy.summaryEn: Mistral's strategy is European sovereignty + enterprise delivery: squeezed between the US and China, it is pivoting to 'Palantir-style' forward-deployed enterprise AI, with clients including HSBC and multiple governments; it launched the Mistral Compute sovereign-infrastructure project with NVIDIA. At Davos, Mensch stated plainly 'Mistral is not for sale' — an IPO is the set course.

agi.summary: Mensch很少谈AGI时间表，其公共叙事聚焦AI的社会角色：在新德里AI行动峰会上主张AI应是“赋能工具，而非支配工具”。这代表了一种欧洲式的中庸——既不加入超级智能竞赛的话语军备，也不回避前沿模型研发，而是把AI定位为产业与主权的赋能层。

quotes.text: AI 应是“赋能工具，而非支配工具”。（新德里AI Action Summit表态）
quotes.textEn: AI should be a tool of empowerment, not a tool of domination. (AI Action Summit, New Delhi; translated from Chinese)

agi.summaryEn: Mensch rarely discusses AGI timelines; his public narrative focuses on AI's social role: at the New Delhi AI Action Summit he argued AI should be 'a tool of empowerment, not domination.' This is a European middle path — joining neither the superintelligence rhetorical arms race nor shying away from frontier-model R&D, but positioning AI as an empowerment layer for industry and sovereignty.

openSource.summary: Mistral是欧洲开放权重路线的代表：从Mistral 7B到Mixtral 8x7B均以开放权重发布。Mensch的理念是“开源的力量在于不同公司可以在彼此的工作之上继续构建”，同时坦承“我们共享权重、共享推理、共享大部分方法……显然也保留了一些制造机密”——开放但不透明，是务实版的开放主义。

quotes.text: The strength of open source is that different companies build on each other. ... We share the weights, we share the inference, we share a large part of the methods... There are obviously some manufacturing secrets that we keep.
quotes.translation: 开源的力量在于不同公司可以在彼此的工作之上继续构建。……我们共享权重、共享推理、共享大部分方法……显然我们也保留了一些制造机密。
quotes.textEn: The strength of open source is that different companies build on each other. ... We share the weights, we share the inference, we share a large part of the methods... There are obviously some manufacturing secrets that we keep.

openSource.summaryEn: Mistral represents Europe's open-weights route: from Mistral 7B to Mixtral 8x7B, all released as open weights. Mensch's creed: 'the strength of open source is that different companies can build on each other's work' — while candidly admitting 'we share weights, we share recipes, most of the method... obviously we keep some manufacturing secrets' — open but not transparent: pragmatist openness.
